assessment.rationale: No open or discoverable solution provides a quality pre-school run by a teacher with an AI assistant in every village, and the Main KPI of 500,000 villages with a quality pre-school is not verifiably met. The nearest known answer is in India: Rocket Learning works with the Anganwadi daycare network and reports about 400,000 Anganwadi workers, about 6 million children and parents, 15 states and about 30% of India's public pre-schools, with play-based content, educator training, WhatsApp groups and an AI-enabled parent coach; its outcome claims (75% school-ready) carry no published method or comparison group (https://rocketlearning.org/). Anganwadi pre-school quality studies report gaps in infrastructure and pre-school education (https://doi.org/10.1007/s44217-025-00555-x), and an Indian RCT of adaptive WhatsApp nudging targets caregiver engagement, not teacher practice (https://doi.org/10.2139/ssrn.7038300). Mobile-based teacher support shows effects in rural Côte d'Ivoire primary schools (https://doi.org/10.3102/00028312261430679). GitHub has no open AI assistant for early-childhood teachers. Honest limit: India's model is close to the KPI in reach, so tasks that replicate WhatsApp content delivery to Anganwadi workers are known answers; the open, checkable work is a teacher-facing AI assistant that measurably raises pre-school quality on a validated instrument, and independently verified quality, outside India as well as in it.

additionalSearches.query: Rocket Learning anganwadi WhatsApp early childhood education evaluation (2024 onward)
additionalSearches.finding: 1 work: 'Adaptive digital nudging improves caregiver engagement at scale: experimental evidence from India' (2026 SSRN, RCT tags, WhatsApp groups, early childhood education). Caregiver engagement, not verified pre-school quality.

additionalSearches.query: preschool quality rural low-income countries teacher AI assistant (2024 onward)
additionalSearches.finding: 481 works: scaling parenting programmes in four LMICs (2025), MugalimAI teacher workload study (2026), targeted instruction with mobile support in rural Cote d'Ivoire (2026). No validated teacher AI assistant for village pre-schools.

additionalSearches.query: anganwadi preschool education learning outcomes quality (2024 onward)
additionalSearches.finding: 254 works: quality of pre-school education in Anganwadi centres (2025), infrastructure, WASH and pre-school education quality comparisons, district critiques (Odisha). Quality gaps are documented.

additionalSearches.query: early childhood education AI teacher assistant (GitHub repositories)
additionalSearches.finding: 0 repositories. Null result for open early-childhood teacher AI assistants.

About 6 million children and parents, about 400,000 Anganwadi workers, 15 states and UTs, 200+ districts, about 30% of India's public pre-schools; AI-enabled parent coach and a GenAI companion called Appu; outcome figures without methodology.
